node.title: Sharp rate-half FPC5 cells shorten to one explicit RS list instance
node.statement: After fixing the full background and two touched petals, every exact sharp rate-half M=4,t=2 contributor injects into RS[C,2ell-1] on |C|=5ell-5 core points, at exact agreement 3ell-2 and radius 2ell-3=floor(2(N-K_0)/3). The FPC5 cofactor, untouched-petal, and first-owner conditions remain filters. This is an exact shortening interface, not a polynomial list-size bound.
